day.en: Every day brings a new chance to learn.
day.cn: 每一天都带来学习的新机会。

fun.en: Learning English can be a lot of fun.

happy.en: Mum is happy when I help her.
A small smile can make people very happy.
happy.cn: 一个小小的微笑能让人非常快乐。

tired.en: I'm tired but happy after a long school day.
tired.cn: 上完一整天课，我又累又开心。

busy.en: Mum is too busy to play with me today.
busy.cn: 妈妈今天太忙，没空陪我玩。

school.en: Our school is big and clean.
I walk to school with my friends every morning.
school.cn: 我每天早上和朋友们走路去上学。

home.en: After a long day, it's nice to be home.
home.cn: 忙碌一天后回到家真好。

great.en: Working together makes us a great team.
great.cn: 齐心协力让我们成为一个很棒的团队。
